payload.rationale: Without a current weather forecast for September 19, 2026, the estimate relies on historical climatology for Miami. The average daily maximum temperature in Miami during mid-to-late September is approximately 89°F. Daily high temperatures in this tropical climate typically have a narrow variance, often falling between 86°F and 92°F. A 2-degree bin (88°F to 89°F) positioned exactly at or just below the climatological mean is expected to capture roughly 25% to 35% of the daily outcomes. The strongest reason this estimate could be too high is if a specific weather system, such as a tropical cyclone or heavy persistent thunderstorms, suppresses temperatures into the low 80s, or if anomalous ridging pushes highs into the low to mid-90s. The strongest reason it could be too low is that 88-89°F represents the most frequent temperature bucket for this time of year, meaning the true probability might be slightly higher if variance is exceptionally low.
